intro: San Diego listings advertise non-climate 10x10 units from about $39, while typical street rates run about $174 in the city and about $220 across the metro. Coastal suburbs pull the metro figure up. Climate-controlled 10x10 street rates sit close to standard units here, but fees and the first existing-customer increase still put the six-month average above the banner price.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Non-climate listings from about $15; many climate-controlled listings start higher, around $37. Climate-controlled street rate ~$80.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Climate-controlled ~$109.

Most rented size. City average $174, down 3.3% YoY (StorageCafe, Sep 2026); StorageUnitCosts lists $178, down 2.2% YoY (Aug 2026). San Diego metro averages $220, down 3.1% YoY (Storage Stats). Climate-controlled city street rate ~$172, slightly under the non-climate figure. Non-climate listings from about $39.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$241.
Three-bedroom home or a car. Climate-controlled ~$318. Non-climate listings from about $148.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Lincoln Park (~$153), Fairmont Park, Palm City and Torrey Pines Preserve (~$162) among the cheapest areas, while Bernardo Springs (~$349) and Carmel Mountain (~$316) run highest.

Nearby cities on the same September 2026 street-rate cut: Encinitas about $201 and Chula Vista about $190 for a non-climate 10x10, against $174 in the city of San Diego. That spread is why the metro average ($220) sits above the city figure.
San Diego's all-unit average is lowest around January (~$196) and highest in August (~$204), StorageCafe.
The city has about 4.1 sq ft of storage per person and 80 facilities (StorageCafe). Only about 91,000 sq ft opened in 2025, so promos are thinner than in markets still adding supply.
On StorageCafe's figures, climate-controlled units in San Diego can price at or below standard units. Price both before paying extra for climate.
Extra Space charges a $50 admin fee (per StorageUnitCosts), higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
